summary: CRITICAL: Missing TestResultsAggregator.Tests.ps1 (referenced in workflow line 21) and fixture files (junit-run1-ubuntu.xml, junit-run2-windows.xml, results-run3-macos.json) that aggregate job expects in fixtures/ dir—workflow cannot run. Type conversions lack error handling: TestResultsAggregator.ps1 lines 52, 73 cast [double] without validation. Invoke-ActTest.ps1 doesn't validate act/git prerequisites. Markdown generation (lines 153–170) verbose; use format-string or heredoc instead of repeated .Add(). JSON parsing (line 94) doesn't validate required fields before access. Otherwise well-documented and readable code, but shipment blocked by missing artifacts and error-handling gaps.
